title: LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy Underwriting Manual — Binding a Rental Building
content:
## 1. What the policy insures

A LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy insures a building rented to others. The named insured's own primary residence is insured under HomeGuard instead, and a condominium unit rented to others under CondoGuard with the unit rental endorsement where its tier allows.

## 2. Conditions of binding

2.1 The building has no more than the tier's maximum number of dwelling units and is let only on a lease type the tier accepts. A lease shorter than the tier's short-term rental threshold (30 days on every tier) is a short-term rental.

2.2 The roof age and the building age at the effective date are within the tier's oldest roof and oldest building accepted at binding.

2.3 Coverage A lies within the tier's lowest and highest Coverage A. The fair rental value limit is the tier's fair rental value percentage of Coverage A. The limit for the landlord's furnishings and appliances is at most the tier's ceiling. Premises liability, the deductible and the wind/hail percentage are chosen from the tier's options, and the billing plan is one the tier allows.

2.4 The roof settlement basis is replacement cost when the roof age at the effective date is at or below the tier's roof replacement-cost age, and the roof surfacing payment schedule otherwise.

## 3. Coverage attaches

A bound policy moves to in force on its effective date. The term runs twelve calendar months.

## 4. Who vouches for what

| Condition | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Number of units and lease type (2.1) | the landlord's statement, taken before binding, for the customer and the building address being bound |
| Roof age and building age at the effective date (2.2) | the landlord's statement together with the roof install year, year built and effective date as recorded, for the same customer and address |

## 5. Acceptance checklist (hypothetical submission)

A hypothetical four-unit building let on month-to-month leases, roof installed 10 years before the effective date, submitted for LandlordGuard DP-2 Broad with Coverage A of 250,000 USD:

- units: 4, within the tier's 4 — meets 2.1;
- lease: month-to-month, accepted on DP-2 Broad — meets 2.1;
- Coverage A: 250,000 USD, within 75,000 to 400,000 USD — meets 2.3;
- fair rental value limit: 10 percent of 250,000 USD, that is 25,000 USD;
- roof settlement: roof age 10, at or below the tier's 12 — replacement cost under 2.4.

The same building with a roof 14 years old at the effective date would be bound with roof surfacing on the payment schedule, since 14 is above 12.
